score_orientation: lower risk score means higher confidence and earlier acceptance
training_sampling: at most 5000 evenly spaced paired blocks per training user
training_weights: equal total weight per user; equal weight per observed y_GT class within each sampled training user; within each user/class, equal weight per observed Flip state; normalize sum of weights to number of training rows
primary_metric: unweighted mean Flip risk across y_GT classes with at least 30 accepted blocks per held-out user and coverage
selection: median across users of per-user class-balanced Flip-risk AUC over fixed 30%-100% coverage; ties: lower 50% balanced risk, lower 30% balanced risk, higher 30% worst-supported-class preservation, simpler method
calibration: per calibration user median of score quantiles across full y_GT classes with at least 30 blocks, then median across calibration users
boundary_safety: negative minimum over competing classes of boundary_distance/(four-view projected SD + 1e-6)

gaussian_crossing.fit: user-weighted nonnegative least squares on squared paired unit-normal projected Fisher errors, training users only
gaussian_crossing.adequacy: pooled training standardized absolute error q95 in [1,3], absolute signed mean <=0.5, and absolute skew <=1.0 in every outer fold; otherwise UNSUPPORTED_GAUSSIAN

outer_folds: Gate4D lexicographic user index modulo 5, with three deterministic disjoint calibration users per fold
final_dev_calibration_allocation: sorted DEV user indices divisible by 5; other 15 users train
